title: is_fips is u32 not bool — correct for UAPI struct ABI
description: Why it is right: struct crypto2dev_provider.is_fips is u32 (and similarly exportable, has_fips_gate, has_key_ops in UAPI structs are __u32). In C, bool has implementation-defined size (typically 1 byte, but compilers differ). In kernel-UAPI structs and in provider registration structs crossed by module boundaries, u32 provides a fixed width, well-defined alignment, and no padding surprises. Linux UAPI headers consistently use __u32 for boolean-valued fields for this reason. What a reviewer might incorrectly suggest: 'use bool for clarity.' bool in a UAPI struct or cross-module struct creates portability and ABI issues: different compilers and kernel configs can choose different sizes, and padding inserted to align a bool-containing struct can differ between kernel and userspace compilation units.
close_reason: confirmed correct: u32 not bool for is_fips provides fixed width, defined alignment, and no padding surprises in UAPI and cross-module structs
